Towards Unified Human Perception and Machine Understanding: Token Flow Guided Compression Framework

面向统一人类感知与机器理解的词元流引导压缩框架

11 页原论文 · 人机双路径 / 可变词元码率 / 语义对齐 · 离线阅读

重点看它如何分开给人看与给机器用的两条路径。这里的机器评测是视觉语言模型任务，与你的检测和分割指标不同。

学习导读 · 以下为阅读辅助分析，与论文译文分开

先建立理解框架

核心问题

固定码率点和偏重像素保真的表示，可能不适合超低码率语义理解。TFGC 使用紧凑一维图像词元，按码率保留部分词元，并学习恢复缺失信息，同时服务视觉重建与机器理解。

推理路径

图像经词元化器变成序列，保留部分词元并编码。接收端 TFP 根据收到的词元恢复缺失部分。人类路径将词元送入解词元器重建图像；机器路径经 TSG 映射成语言模型可用的视觉语义表示，无需先恢复像素再运行完整视觉编码器。

关键公式

TFP 的 x̂_m=μ_θ(x_u)+σ_θ(x_u)⊙ε 表示条件高斯采样：已收到词元决定缺失词元的均值与不确定性。均值是预测中心，尺度控制采样变化。高斯建模推导服务于可学习近似，并不证明真实词元严格服从高斯。

训练分工

TSG 先用 MSE 对齐冻结视觉语言模型的视觉编码器与适配器输出，再结合语义对齐和下一词元交叉熵做任务训练。论文使用 TiTok-sl256、InternVL2-1B，以及图像和多任务图文数据。阅读时逐阶段确认哪些模块冻结，哪些更新。

实验边界

机器任务包括图像描述、指代表达定位、视觉问答，指标涉及 ROUGE-L、Acc@0.5、准确率；视觉路径评估 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS、DISTS、CLIP-IQA。正文有‘所有任务最优’的概括，但表格部分单项未必最高，应逐数据集、码率和指标读取。这些分数不能直接与 COCO 检测 AP、PQ、关键点 AP 比较。

与你的研究对照

共同点是人机双目标与语义保留。差别在于 TFGC 面向词元到语言模型的直接接口，你的方法评估重建图像上的检测、分割、关键点等任务。值得思考：机器路径是否必须经过像素重建？另设特征路径时，要交代新增码流、网络成本和公平基准。

自检问题

降低码率时舍弃哪些词元？预测缺失词元是否增加比特？TSG 的教师目标来自哪里？给语言模型的表示能否直接用于当前检测器？视觉质量与机器任务是否在所有码率同步改善？

Towards Unified Human Perception and Machine Understanding: Token Flow Guided Compression Framework

迈向统一的人类感知与机器理解：Token 流引导的压缩框架

Li Xu, Yingfu Zhang, Kepeng Xu, Gang He*, Yunsong Li Xidian University, Xi’an, Shaanxi, China

Li Xu、Yingfu Zhang、Kepeng Xu、Gang He*、Yunsong Li。西安电子科技大学，中国陕西西安。

xuli@xidian.edu.cn, zhangyingfu@stu.xidian.edu.cn, kepengxu11@gmail.com,

xuli@xidian.edu.cn, zhangyingfu@stu.xidian.edu.cn, kepengxu11@gmail.com,

ghe@xidian.edu.cn, ysli@mail.xidian.edu.cn

ghe@xidian.edu.cn, ysli@mail.xidian.edu.cn

Abstract

摘要

With the rapid rise of Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) for image understanding, the objective of image compression is gradually shifting from human visual perception to machine-oriented semantic understanding.

随着用于图像理解的大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）迅速发展，图像压缩的目标正逐渐从人类视觉感知转向面向机器的语义理解。

However, conventional learned compression techniques are optimized for pixel-level fidelity and typically operate at fixed or rigid bitrate points, misaligned with the semantic consistency and flexible bitrate control.

然而，传统学习式压缩技术主要针对像素级保真度进行优化，通常只能在固定或缺乏灵活性的码率点上工作，难以兼顾语义一致性与灵活码率控制。

This gap becomes critical in ultra-low-bitrate regimes, where latent representations often ignore semantic relevance and struggle to disentangle meaningful content from redundant visual details as the bitrate varies.

这一差距在超低码率条件下尤为关键，因为潜在表示往往忽略语义相关性，并且难以在码率变化时将有意义的内容与冗余视觉细节分离。

To address these challenges, we develop a token-based flexible compression framework, Token Flow Guided Compression (TFGC), which unifies humanand machine-oriented objectives.

为应对这些挑战，我们提出基于 token 的灵活压缩框架 Token Flow Guided Compression（TFGC），统一面向人类和机器的目标。

TFGC supports variable bitrate control in ultra-low bitrate regimes and enables LVLMs to directly process compressed tokens without image reconstruction.

TFGC 支持超低码率下的可变码率控制，并使 LVLM 无需重建图像即可直接处理压缩后的 token。

Specifically, we explore the token flow phenomenon in 1D token sequences and exploit it to design token flow propagation, which predicts missing tokens by propagating contextual information from unmasked tokens.

具体而言，我们研究一维 token 序列中的 token 流现象，并据此设计 token 流传播机制，通过传播未掩蔽 token 的上下文信息预测缺失 token。

Moreover, token semantic guidance aligns compressed representations with LVLM semantic space, while a progressive semantic alignment training strategy further bridges the gap between perceptual reconstruction and semantic reasoning.

此外，token 语义引导将压缩表示与 LVLM 的语义空间对齐，而渐进式语义对齐训练策略进一步缩小感知重建与语义推理之间的差距。

Experiments show that our framework achieves state-of-the-art LVLMs understanding at comparable bitrates while maintaining satisfactory perceptual quality.

实验表明，在相近码率下，该框架实现了领先的 LVLM 理解性能，同时保持令人满意的感知质量。

1. Introduction

1. 引言

Large Vision-Language Models [1, 3, 32, 38, 66] (LVLMs) have significantly advanced multi-task image understanding by integrating visual features into LLMs, redefining how visual data are consumed by both humans and machines.

大型视觉语言模型 [1,3,32,38,66]（LVLM）将视觉特征融入大语言模型，显著推动了多任务图像理解的发展，重新定义了人类与机器使用视觉数据的方式。

This shift fundamentally changes the objective of image compression, which must now preserve not only perceptual fidelity but also semantic consistency for machine reasoning [28, 58].

这一转变从根本上改变了图像压缩的目标，使其既要保持感知保真度，也要保持机器推理所需的语义一致性 [28,58]。

Meanwhile, real-world scenarios such as satellite transmission and edge devices demand ultra-low and variable bitrate compression under constrained bandwidth and computation [19, 25, 35, 52, 54].

与此同时，卫星传输和边缘设备等实际场景要求在有限带宽与算力下实现超低码率和可变码率压缩 [19,25,35,52,54]。

Existing learned autoencoder-based image compression methods can be categorized as follows.

现有基于自编码器的学习式图像压缩方法可作如下分类。

Typical approaches [17, 18, 20, 26, 49, 67] employ an autoencoder framework [21] that jointly optimizes, achieving superior performance over traditional codecs such as BPG [4], and VVC [6].

典型方法 [17,18,20,26,49,67] 使用联合优化的自编码器框架 [21]，性能优于 BPG [4]、VVC [6] 等传统编解码器。

However, these models are usually trained for a specific bitrate by tuning the rate–distortion coefficient λ in the loss R + λD, requiring retraining or storing separate checkpoints for different operating points.

然而，这些模型通常通过调整损失 R+λD 中的率失真系数 λ，针对特定码率训练，因此不同工作点需要重新训练或保存独立检查点。

To address this limitation, QVRF [52] introduces a quantization-regulator vector for controlling latent quantization error, while Hanyue [54] employs a lightweight multi-scale invertible transform for unified bitrate control.

为解决这一限制，QVRF [52] 引入量化调节向量来控制潜变量量化误差，Hanyue [54] 则使用轻量的多尺度可逆变换实现统一码率控制。

图1. 在 0.06 bpp 下，TFGC 与现有先进方法在面向机器的基准上的比较。

Each axis corresponds to a dataset and its respective evaluation metric, where higher values indicate better performance.

每个轴对应一个数据集及其评测指标，数值越高表示性能越好。

With the rise of LVLMs, recent works [28, 39] attempt to incorporate semantic priors into compression.

随着 LVLM 兴起，近期工作 [28,39] 尝试将语义先验融入压缩。

However, these methods still rely on reconstructed images, creating a modality gap between perceptual fidelity and machine understanding.

然而，这些方法仍依赖重建图像，使感知保真度与机器理解之间存在模态差距。

This issue becomes more pronounced in ultralow bitrate regimes [25, 30, 53, 59], where semantic degradation severely impacts downstream reasoning.

在超低码率条件下 [25,30,53,59]，语义退化严重影响下游推理，使这一问题更加突出。

This underscores the necessity of maintaining semantic integrity when operating in ultra-low-bitrate regimes.

这凸显了在超低码率下保持语义完整性的必要性。

Recent Vector-Quantized (VQ) based approaches [23, 41, 44] transmit discrete token indices but typically rely on dense 2D token grids, limiting compression flexibility.

近期基于向量量化（VQ）的方法 [23,41,44] 传输离散 token 索引，但通常依赖密集的二维 token 网格，限制了压缩灵活性。

In contrast, our approach employs a tokenizer-based 1D token representation that is both more compact and semantically enriched, yielding higher compression efficiency and a more informative latent stream for LVLM-based image understanding.

相比之下，我们采用基于 tokenizer 的一维 token 表示，其更紧凑且语义更丰富，既提高压缩效率，也为基于 LVLM 的图像理解提供信息更充分的潜在码流。

To further explore the structural and semantic characteristics of these 1D tokens, we conduct token information perturbation analyses, as shown in Fig.3.

为进一步研究这些一维 token 的结构与语义特性，我们进行了图3所示的 token 信息扰动分析。

By comparing the effects of injecting different types of perturbations, we observe a unique property of 1D tokens—token flow—which reflects their inherent ability to preserve global consistency across the sequence.

通过比较不同扰动的影响，我们观察到一维 token 的一种独特属性——token 流，它体现了序列保持全局一致性的内在能力。

Leveraging this insight, we propose Token Flow Guided Compression (TFGC), a unified compression framework jointly optimized for human perception and machine understanding.

基于这一发现，我们提出 Token Flow Guided Compression（TFGC），作为联合面向人类感知与机器理解优化的统一压缩框架。

Main contributions are summarized as follows:

主要贡献如下：

• We explore an inherent phenomenon in 1D token representations, termed “token flow”, which describes the dynamic propagation of semantic information across token sequences.

我们研究一维 token 表示中称为“token 流”的内在现象，描述语义信息在 token 序列中的动态传播。

Building on this insight, we develop the Token Flow Guided Compression (TFGC) framework, enabling variable-bitrate adaptation and direct LVLM consumption of the compressed bitstream.

基于这一发现，我们构建 TFGC 框架，实现可变码率适配，并允许 LVLM 直接使用压缩码流。

• We design a Token Flow Propagation (TFP) module tailored for variable-bitrate settings.

我们设计了面向可变码率场景的 Token Flow Propagation（TFP，token 流传播）模块。

By modeling masked tokens as conditional Gaussian distributions and adaptively transforming a standard Gaussian prior into target conditionals, TFP achieves fine-grained bitrate modulation within a single model.

通过将掩蔽 token 建模为条件高斯分布，并自适应地将标准高斯先验变换为目标条件分布，TFP 在单一模型内实现细粒度码率调节。

• We introduce a lightweight Token Semantic Guidance (TSG) module that aligns visual tokens with the semantic features expected by LVLMs.

我们引入轻量的 Token Semantic Guidance（TSG，token 语义引导）模块，将视觉 token 与 LVLM 所期望的语义特征对齐。

By bypassing the redundant “decode-then-encode” process, TSG enables direct token-based reasoning and substantially enhances understanding performance under ultra-low bitrates.

TSG 绕过冗余的“先解码、再编码”过程，实现直接基于 token 的推理，显著改善超低码率下的理解性能。

2. Related Work

2. 相关工作

Image Compression. End-to-end neural compression, particularly autoencoder-based methods [12, 42, 46], has substantially improved over classical codecs but often yields overly smooth reconstructions and missing details at ultralow bitrates [22].

图像压缩。端到端神经压缩，尤其是基于自编码器的方法 [12,42,46]，相较传统编解码器已有显著进步，但在超低码率下常出现重建过度平滑和细节缺失 [22]。

[7, 25, 35] leverage diffusion-based generation to synthesize fine details at extremely low rates.

文献 [7,25,35] 利用扩散生成在极低码率下合成精细细节。

However, most end-to-end models lack flexible variable-bitrate control and typically require retraining or maintaining separate models per bitrate, incurring substantial computational and storage costs.

然而，大多数端到端模型缺乏灵活的可变码率控制，通常需要为每个码率重新训练或维护独立模型，带来较大的计算与存储成本。

To address variable bitrate requirements, other approaches [52, 54] leverage conditioning vectors or scale-adaptive transforms to modulate the latent features, enabling operating different bitrates without retraining separate models.

针对可变码率需求，其他方法 [52,54] 利用条件向量或尺度自适应变换调节潜在特征，无需分别重新训练模型即可在不同码率下工作。Token 压缩。

Token Compression. Vector-quantized (VQ) token–based compression, which transmits discrete token indices rather than quantized features, has recently attracted growing attention.

基于向量量化 token 的压缩传输离散 token 索引，而非量化特征，近期受到越来越多关注。这些方法使用的编码器通常分为二维自编码器和一维 tokenizer。

Such approaches typically use encoders that fall into 2D autoencoders and 1D tokenizers.

二维自编码器 [13,27,50,55] 将图像块映射为潜在 token，从而保留空间对应关系；

The 2D autoencoders [13, 27, 50, 55] preserve spatial alignment by mapping image patches to latent tokens, whereas 1D tokenizers [2, 8, 47, 61] leverage Transformer-based [56] architectures to capture more compact semantic information of image.

一维 tokenizer [2,8,47,61] 则通过基于 Transformer [56] 的结构提取更紧凑的图像语义信息。

To further compress token sequence, existing methods either employ non-learned approaches such as clustering or folding to modify the sequence’s geometric structure [29, 31, 48, 64], or introduce learnable masking guided by external textual cues or static token registers to refine the sequence’s content [2, 40, 62].

为进一步压缩 token 序列，现有方法或者使用聚类、折叠等非学习方法改变序列的几何结构 [29,31,48,64]，或者引入由外部文本线索或静态 token 寄存器引导的可学习掩蔽，以调整序列内容 [2,40,62]。

These methods lack flexibility in token-sequence compression and recovery.

这些方法在 token 序列压缩与恢复方面缺乏灵活性。

In our work, we employ a token dropout strategy to reduce sequence length and introduce a token flow propagated prediction strategy to recover the complete sequence, enabling adaptive and effective variable bitrate compression.

我们通过 token 丢弃策略缩短序列，并引入基于 token 流传播的预测策略恢复完整序列，实现自适应且有效的可变码率压缩。

Compression for Machine. Recently, compression for machine perception has gained increasing attention.

面向机器的压缩。近年来，面向机器感知的压缩受到越来越多关注。

Some approaches [33, 34, 51, 63] train compression systems with specific downstream networks to optimize performance for targeted tasks.

部分方法 [33,34,51,63] 将压缩系统与特定下游网络共同训练，优化目标任务性能。

However, such methods are task-specific, requiring retraining for each new application.

然而，这类方法具有任务专用性，每个新应用都需要重新训练。

With LVLMs unifying diverse vision tasks, [28, 39] add semantic preediting or pre-selection to make compressed images oriented toward LVLMs.

随着 LVLM 统一多种视觉任务，文献 [28,39] 引入语义预编辑或预选择，使压缩图像适合 LVLM 使用。

In our work, our framework uses lightweight semantic guidance to bypass redundant decodethen-encode steps, allowing the compressed token bitstream to be directly interpreted as visual features for LLMs.

我们的框架使用轻量语义引导绕过冗余的先解码再编码步骤，使压缩 token 码流可直接解释为大语言模型的视觉特征。

3. Method

3. 方法

3.1. Overall Architecture

3.1. 整体架构

In this study, we investigate a unified variable bitrate image compression framework, Token Flow Guided Compression

本研究考察一种统一的可变码率图像压缩框架 Token Flow Guided Compression。

A:“The image shows a magpie with blue and white feathers perched on a tree branch.”

回答：“图像中，一只蓝白色羽毛的喜鹊栖息在树枝上。”

T F P

TFP：token 流传播。

Figure 2. Overview of the proposed TFGC framework. The image is first tokenized into a 1D sequence.

图2. 所提出 TFGC 框架的概览。图像首先被转换为一维 token 序列。

A variable token masker removes a controllable portion of tokens according to the target bitrate, and the remaining tokens are entropy-coded into a bitstream via an arithmetic encoder.

可变 token 掩蔽器根据目标码率移除可控比例的 token，剩余 token 通过算术编码器熵编码为码流。

At the decoder, the bitstream is recovered by the arithmetic decoder and passed to the TFP module, which predicts the missing tokens and reconstructs the complete token sequence.

在解码端，算术解码器恢复码流，并将其送入 TFP 模块，预测缺失 token，重建完整 token 序列。

(TFGC), that jointly supports human visual perception and machine understanding under extremely low-bitrate constraints.

TFGC 在极低码率约束下同时支持人类视觉感知与机器理解。

As shown in Fig. 2, TFGC consists of four key components: (1) a 1D tokenizer–detokenizer for visual tokenization and reconstruction, (2) a variable bitrate control module based on Token Flow Propagation (TFP), (3) a Token Semantic Guidance (TSG) module for semantic alignment, and (4) a large language model (LLM) for downstream understanding.

如图2所示，TFGC 包含四个主要组件：（1）用于视觉 token 化与重建的一维 tokenizer–detokenizer，（2）基于 TFP 的可变码率控制模块，（3）用于语义对齐的 TSG 模块，以及（4）用于下游理解的大语言模型。

Specifically, at the encoder side, the image is first converted into 1D token sequences by the tokenizer.

具体而言，在编码端，图像首先由 tokenizer 转换成一维 token 序列。

A variable token masker removes a controllable portion of tokens based on the target bitrate, and the remaining unmasked tokens are entropy-coded into a bitstream using an arithmetic encoder.

可变 token 掩蔽器依据目标码率移除可控比例的 token，剩余未掩蔽 token 通过算术编码器熵编码为码流。

At the decoder side, the transmitted bitstream is recovered by the arithmetic decoder, followed by the TFP module, which predicts the missing tokens to reconstruct the full token sequence.

在解码端，算术解码器恢复传输码流，随后由 TFP 模块预测缺失 token，恢复完整序列。

This reconstructed token sequence serves two parallel pathways: (i) image reconstruction through the detokenizer for human-oriented perception, and (ii) semantic adaptation through the TSG module for LLM-based understanding.

重建的 token 序列进入两个并行分支：（i）通过 detokenizer 重建图像，服务人类感知；（ii）通过 TSG 模块进行语义适配，服务基于大语言模型的理解。

3.2. Token Flow Perceptual Reconstruction

3.2. 基于 token 流的感知重建

3.2.1. Token Flow

3.2.1. Token 流

The 1D token sequence removes the spatial correspondence inherent in 2D tokens, resulting in a highly compressed representation [2, 61], which is mainly manifested in its “feature representation” properties.

一维 token 序列去除了二维 token 固有的空间对应关系，形成高度压缩的表示 [2,61]，这主要体现在其“特征表示”属性上。

[5] pointed out the positional property of feature representation, which means tokens at specific positions tend to encode specific attributes such as color, pose, background, etc.

文献 [5] 指出了特征表示的位置属性，即特定位置的 token 倾向于编码颜色、姿态、背景等特定属性。

[2] highlighted the sequential property of feature representation, noting that tokens at the beginning of the sequence tend to encode global features, while tokens toward the end capture fine-grained details.

文献 [2] 强调了特征表示的序列属性，指出序列前部 token 倾向于编码全局特征，而后部 token 捕获细粒度细节。

In this paper, we emphasize the holistic property of feature representation: the entire token sequence jointly carries the semantic and structural information of the image, making token-based variable-rate control possible.

本文强调特征表示的整体属性：整个 token 序列共同承载图像的语义与结构信息，从而使基于 token 的可变码率控制成为可能。

Moreover, the Transformer-based architecture of the 1D tokenizer naturally introduces a self-attention mechanism, which transforms this holistic representation into a dynamic process of information exchange.

此外，一维 tokenizer 的 Transformer 架构自然引入自注意力机制，将这种整体表示转变为动态的信息交换过程。

This mechanism compensates for the loss of explicit spatial relationships caused by flattening 2D features into a 1D sequence, allowing tokens to communicate globally and model long-range dependencies.

该机制补偿了二维特征展平为一维序列后显式空间关系的丢失，使 token 能够进行全局交互并建模长程依赖。

We refer to this as token flow, which describes how visual information is globally propagated and contextually recovered within the 1D token sequence.

我们将其称为 token 流，用于描述视觉信息如何在一维 token 序列中进行全局传播和上下文恢复。

We conducted token flow perturbation experiments to verify the holistic property in 1D token representations.

我们通过 token 流扰动实验验证一维 token 表示的整体属性。

As shown in Fig. 3, two perturbation types are explored: obstruction tokens that introduce foreign information relative to the original token sequence, and uninformative tokens that simply remove information without inserting new content.

如图3所示，实验考虑两类扰动：引入相对于原序列的外来信息的干扰 token，以及仅移除信息而不引入新内容的无信息 token。

For obstruction tokens, we replace the tail tokens of the original sequence with randomly sampled tokens from the codebook.

对于干扰 token，我们使用从码本中随机采样的 token 替换原序列尾部 token。

When only a few obstruction tokens are inserted, the reconstructed image maintains a stable overall style;

仅插入少量干扰 token 时，重建图像的整体风格仍较稳定；

however, increasing their proportion gradually disrupts the information flow, leading to severe degradation.

但随着其比例增加，信息流逐渐被破坏，导致严重退化。

In contrast, for uninformative tokens, we directly remove tokens at the end or at random positions.

对于无信息 token，我们直接移除序列末端或随机位置的 token。

We find that this usually causes less disruption than introducing the same number of obstruction tokens.

我们发现，与引入同等数量的干扰 token 相比，这通常造成更小的破坏。

This arises from the token flow in the 1D tokenizer, which allows remaining valid tokens that carry holistic features to propagate contextual information globally.

这源于一维 tokenizer 中的 token 流：剩余携带整体特征的有效 token 能够在全局传播上下文信息。

However, when excessive obstruction tokens are introduced, their interference overwhelms meaningful information exchange, whereas uninformative tokens merely remove information without injecting conflicting noise.

然而，过多干扰 token 会使有意义的信息交换被干扰淹没，而无信息 token 只移除信息，并不注入相互冲突的噪声。

3.2.2. Token Flow Propagation

3.2.2. Token 流传播

Several techniques have been developed for compressing 1D token sequences—such as pixelshuffle, token folding, clustering, and dropout—enabling a single model to generate representations at multiple compression levels by adjusting the number of retained tokens.

现有一维 token 序列压缩技术包括 pixelshuffle、token 折叠、聚类和丢弃等，通过调整保留 token 的数量，使单一模型产生不同压缩程度的表示。

Nevertheless, these approaches mainly emphasize token reduction while neglecting the modeling of information prediction or recovery from the compressed representations.

然而，这些方法主要关注减少 token，忽略了从压缩表示预测或恢复信息的建模。

This limitation becomes critical in variable-bitrate scenarios, where reliable recovery of the full token sequence from reduced representations is essential for maintaining content consistency across different bitrate levels.

在可变码率场景中，这一限制尤为关键，因为要在不同码率下保持内容一致性，就必须从缩减表示中可靠恢复完整 token 序列。

This inspires us to explore methods to maximize informative content transmission while minimizing the introduction of external disruptive noise.

这启发我们探索在尽量减少外部干扰噪声的同时，最大化有效信息传输的方法。

However, existing token prediction techniques [2, 40, 62]—whether implemented as a single learnable token or as a set of learnable tokens with positional encoding to supplement the original token sequence—are inherently static, meaning that they operate independently of other tokens.

然而，现有 token 预测技术 [2,40,62] 无论使用单个可学习 token，还是使用带位置编码的一组可学习 token 来补全原序列，本质上都是静态的，即独立于其他 token 工作。

Consequently, the model is forced to learn a replacement token distribution that is applied across all contexts, which weakens the information flow capability of 1D tokens.

因此，模型被迫学习一个适用于所有上下文的替代 token 分布，削弱了一维 token 的信息流能力。

Let the original token sequence be x = (x1, x2, ..., xN), and partition it into unmasked part xu = (x1, x2, ..., xn) and masked part xm = (x(n+1), x(n+2), ..., xN).

设原 token 序列为 x=(x₁,x₂,…,xN)，将其划分为未掩蔽部分 xu=(x₁,…,xn) 和掩蔽部分 xm=(xₙ₊₁,…,xN)。

Let the true joint distribution be P(x) = P(xu, xm) = P(xu)P(xm|xu), and let F(xm) be an arbitrary contextfree distribution.

设真实联合分布为 P(x)=P(xu,xm)=P(xu)P(xm|xu)，F(xm) 为任意不依赖上下文的分布。

A static token filling strategy corresponds to a joint distribution Q(x) = P(xu)F(xm).

静态 token 填充策略对应联合分布 Q(x)=P(xu)F(xm)。

The distance between the true distribution and the static token joint distribution can be expressed via KL divergence:

真实分布与静态 token 联合分布之间的差异可用 KL 散度表示：

Figure 4. Structure of Token Flow Propagation (TFP). The TFP module models masked tokens xm conditioned on unmasked tokens xu as samples from a conditional Gaussian distribution.

图4. Token Flow Propagation（TFP）的结构。TFP 将以未掩蔽 token xu 为条件的掩蔽 token xm 建模为条件高斯分布中的样本。

P(xu)F(xm) = Ex∼P [log P(xm|xu) −log F(xm)]

公式中的比值分母为 P(xu)F(xm)；展开后可得到期望形式 E[log P(xm|xu)−log F(xm)]。完整等式参见本页原始公式。

That is, the discrepancy caused by replacement equals the average KL divergence between the conditional distribution P(xm|xu) and the replacement distribution F.

也就是说，替换造成的差异等于条件分布 P(xm|xu) 与替代分布 F 之间的平均 KL 散度。

As long as the unmasked part xu and the masked part xm are not independent, any F unrelated to the conditional distribution will generally make the above expression positive and significant.

只要未掩蔽部分 xu 与掩蔽部分 xm 并非独立，任何与条件分布无关的 F 通常都会使上述表达式为正且较大。

This proves that replacing with context-free static tokens disrupts the original global feature structure.

这证明，使用不依赖上下文的静态 token 替换会破坏原有全局特征结构。

To preserve the inter-token dependencies induced by token flow, we instead aim to model the conditional distribution P(xm|xu).

为保留 token 流所产生的 token 间依赖，我们转而建模条件分布 P(xm|xu)。

For analytical tractability, we assume that the joint distribution P(xu, xm) follows a multivariate Gaussian form, which provides a closed-form expression for its conditional: P(xm|xu) = N(µm|u, Σm|u), where

为便于分析，我们假设联合分布 P(xu,xm) 服从多元高斯分布，其条件分布具有闭式表达 P(xm|xu)=N(μm|u,Σm|u)，其中：

展开 PDF 第 4 页 · 完整图表、公式与文献Open PDF page 4 · figures, formulas & references

原版页面保留数值、图例与排版，可使用浏览器放大查看。

PDF 05 / 11查看本页图表与原式 ↗Figures & formulas ↗

The conditional mean µm|u, being an affine function of xu, supports the theoretical foundation for predicting the missing tokens xm from the unmasked tokens xu.

条件均值 μm|u 是 xu 的仿射函数，为根据未掩蔽 token xu 预测缺失 token xm 提供理论基础。

The conditional covariance Σm|u is independent of xu, implying that a single scale is sufficient to characterize the uncertainty of the missing region.

条件协方差 Σm|u 与 xu 无关，意味着单一尺度足以描述缺失区域的不确定性。

This property supports a parameterized conditional modeling framework that captures both prediction and uncertainty.

该属性支持同时刻画预测和不确定性的参数化条件建模框架。

In practice, we adopt a parameterized conditional distribution strategy: let µθ(xu) denote the network prediction that approximates the true conditional mean µm|u and let σθ(xu) denote a network output that parameterizes the conditional scale, relaxing the fixed-covariance assumption of the strict Gaussian model.

在实践中，我们采用参数化条件分布策略，以网络预测 μθ(xu) 近似真实条件均值，并以网络输出 σθ(xu) 参数化条件尺度，从而放宽严格高斯模型中的固定协方差假设。

Sampling from the learned conditional is done via reparameterization:

通过重参数化从学习到的条件分布中采样：

where ⊙denotes elemen-wise multiplication, ˆxm denotes the conditionally mapped tokens, and y is a standard normal vector of the same dimensionality as xm.

其中，⊙ 表示逐元素乘法，x̂m 表示经过条件映射的 token，y 是与 xm 维数相同的标准正态向量。

Structurally, as shown in Fig.4, we first initialize the masked tokens from a standard normal distribution to serve as the objects for conditional mapping, denoted as y.

在结构上，如图4所示，我们首先从标准正态分布初始化掩蔽 token，作为条件映射的对象，记为 y。

The unmasked tokens are first passed through a normalization layer and then fed into a self-attention layer, allowing token information to propagate across the sequence.

未掩蔽 token 先经过归一化层，再进入自注意力层，使 token 信息沿序列传播。

Next, an MLP predicts the conditional mean and variance, and the masked tokens initialized from the standard Gaussian are mapped, using the predicted conditional mean and variance, to the target tokens in the sequence.

随后，MLP 预测条件均值和方差，并利用这些预测，将由标准高斯初始化的掩蔽 token 映射成序列中的目标 token。

Finally, the unmasked tokens xu are concatenated with the conditionally mapped tokens ˆxm to form the reconstructed token sequence.

最后，将未掩蔽 token xu 与条件映射后的 token x̂m 拼接，形成重建 token 序列。

3.3. Token Semantic Guided Understanding

3.3. Token 语义引导的理解

Unlike conventional paradigms [15, 28, 33, 34, 39] that reconstruct images before feeding them into LVLMs, our TFGC framework directly enables LVLMs to perform understanding tasks on reconstructed token sequences.

传统范式 [15,28,33,34,39] 先重建图像再将其输入 LVLM，而 TFGC 直接让 LVLM 在重建 token 序列上执行理解任务。

From the token flow perturbation analysis, 1D tokens exhibit a holistic property, carrying fine-grained visual details and latent semantic potential.

Token 流扰动分析表明，一维 token 具有整体属性，承载细粒度视觉细节和潜在语义能力。

While these tokens implicitly contain semantic correlations, they remain visually oriented and lack explicit alignment with the linguistic space of LVLMs.

尽管这些 token 隐含语义关联，它们仍以视觉重建为导向，尚未显式对齐 LVLM 的语言空间。

By explicitly guiding this latent semantics through the proposed Token Semantic Guidance (TSG) module, the reconstructed token sequence can be directly interpreted by LVLMs without decoding it back into an image.

所提出的 TSG 模块显式引导这些潜在语义，使重建 token 序列可直接被 LVLM 理解，无需解码回图像。

This enables a more efficient, image-independent pathway for machine-oriented understanding.

这为面向机器的理解提供了一条更高效、无需图像重建的路径。TSG 模块。

TSG Module. For the image reconstruction path, these tokens primarily capture structural and visual information optimized for reconstruction rather than semantics.

在图像重建分支中，这些 token 主要包含针对重建而非语义优化的结构与视觉信息。

The TSG module injects CLIP-driven semantic priors and projects these tokens into a language-compatible embedding space.

TSG 注入由 CLIP 引导的语义先验，并将 token 投影到与语言兼容的嵌入空间。

Concretely, the reconstructed token sequence is first projected by an MLP into the LLM embedding dimension, then refined by stacked TSG layers—each composed of normalization, self-attention, and residual MLP blocks—to propagate and align semantic information.

具体而言，重建 token 序列先由 MLP 映射至 LLM 嵌入维度，再通过堆叠的 TSG 层细化；每层由归一化、自注意力和残差 MLP 块构成，用于传播并对齐语义信息。

Finally, the semantically guided tokens are concatenated with textual prompts and fed into the frozen LLM to produce the final result.

最后，将语义引导后的 token 与文本提示拼接，输入冻结的 LLM 得到最终结果。

This process transforms the information flow from a visioncentric reconstruction pathway to a language-oriented semantic reasoning stream, bridging the gap between visual compression and linguistic understanding.

这将信息流从以视觉为中心的重建路径转变为面向语言的语义推理流，缩小视觉压缩与语言理解之间的差距。

Progressive Semantic Alignment Training Paradigm.

渐进式语义对齐训练范式。

To bridge the modality gap between reconstruction-oriented visual tokens and the linguistic feature manifold, we propose a Progressive Semantic Alignment (PSA) paradigm for training the TSG module.

为弥合面向重建的视觉 token 与语言特征流形之间的模态差距，我们提出渐进式语义对齐（PSA）范式来训练 TSG 模块。

This design ensures stable convergence and avoids the instability of directly optimizing a high-dimensional mapping without semantic priors.

这一设计确保稳定收敛，避免缺乏语义先验时直接优化高维映射所导致的不稳定。

Stage I — Semantic Grounding.

阶段一——语义基础对齐。

The first stage establishes an initial semantic anchor between compressed token embeddings and the latent feature space that the LLM’s visual encoder is familiar with.

第一阶段在压缩 token 嵌入与 LLM 视觉编码器熟悉的潜在特征空间之间建立初始语义锚点。

As shown in Fig. 5, the original image is passed through the frozen LVLM’s vision encoder and adapter to obtain the reference semantic features FV E, which serve as supervision targets. The TSG output FT SG is then optimized to align with FV E via a mean squared error (MSE) loss LP SA1.

如图5所示，原始图像通过冻结的 LVLM 视觉编码器及适配器，得到用于监督的参考语义特征 FVE。随后使用均方误差损失 LPSA1，优化 TSG 输出 FTSG 与 FVE 的对齐。

This semantic grounding step effectively constrains the representation space and provides a warm-up prior that stabilizes training, ensuring the tokens lie on a semantically meaningful manifold.

这一步有效约束表示空间，并提供稳定训练的预热先验，确保 token 位于具有语义意义的流形上。

Stage II — Instruction Alignment.

阶段二——指令对齐。

Once semantically grounded, the focus shifts from feature similarity to functional alignment with instruction-level reasoning.

建立语义基础之后，优化重点从特征相似性转向与指令级推理的功能对齐。

Here, FT SG is concatenated with the text tokens and fed into the frozen LLM for next-token prediction, enabling the model to learn task-level instruction alignment.

此时，将 FTSG 与文本 token 拼接，送入冻结的 LLM 进行下一 token 预测，从而学习任务层面的指令对齐。

This stage uses a joint loss LP SA2 combining cross-entropy and the semantic regularization term. Through this refinement, the TSG output evolves from static semantic resemblance to functional compatibility, enabling LVLMs to directly consume compressed token streams for downstream reasoning tasks.

该阶段采用结合交叉熵与语义正则项的联合损失 LPSA2。通过这种细化，TSG 输出从静态语义相似发展为功能兼容，使 LVLM 可直接使用压缩 token 流完成下游推理。

Figure 5. Progressive Semantic Alignment (PSA) training paradigm. Stage I (Semantic Grounding): TSG output tokens are aligned with the frozen vision encoder’s features via MSE loss.

图5. 渐进式语义对齐（PSA）训练范式。阶段一（语义基础对齐）：通过 MSE 损失，将 TSG 输出 token 与冻结视觉编码器的特征对齐。

Stage II (Instruction Alignment): semantically grounded tokens are concatenated with text tokens and optimized via combined MSE and cross-entropy objectives for next-token prediction.

阶段二（指令对齐）：将具有语义基础的 token 与文本 token 拼接，结合 MSE 和交叉熵目标进行下一 token 预测优化。

4. Experiments

4. 实验

4.1. Implementation Details

4.1. 实现细节

TFGC decouples the optimization for human perception and machine understanding into two stages, thus avoiding performance compromise between the two objectives.

TFGC 将人类感知与机器理解的优化解耦为两个阶段，从而避免两类目标之间的性能妥协。

For human perception optimization, we employ the TiTok-sl256 [61] as our initial 1D tokenizer and detokenizer, freezing the codebook while training encoder, decoder, and TFP modules.

对于人类感知优化，我们使用 TiTok-sl256 [61] 初始化一维 tokenizer 与 detokenizer，冻结码本，同时训练编码器、解码器和 TFP 模块。

The overall loss is LT F P = αL2 + βLperceptual + γLadv with α=1.0, β=1.1, and γ=0.1.

总损失为 LTFP=αL₂+βLperceptual+γLadv，其中 α=1.0、β=1.1、γ=0.1。

The model is trained on ImageNet-1K [10] with batch size 32 on V100 GPUs.

模型在 ImageNet-1K [10] 上训练，批量大小为32，使用 V100 GPU。

For machine understanding optimization, the TSG module is trained using the proposed PSA paradigm while keeping previous components frozen.

对于机器理解优化，保持前述组件冻结，使用 PSA 范式训练 TSG 模块。

We build upon InternVL2-1B [9] and use its frozen vision encoder and adapter for MSE supervision.

我们基于 InternVL2-1B [9]，使用其冻结的视觉编码器和适配器提供 MSE 监督。

The model is trained on 380k image–text pairs from COCO [37], Ref- COCO/RefCOCOg [24, 43], and VQAv2/OKVQA [16, 45].

训练数据包含来自 COCO [37]、RefCOCO/RefCOCOg [24,43] 和 VQAv2/OKVQA [16,45] 的38万图文对。

4.2. Machine-Oriented Evaluation

4.2. 面向机器的评测

Evaluation Protocol. To evaluate TFGC from a machineoriented perspective, we conduct experiments across multiple downstream scenarios, covering diverse visual-language tasks and multiple compression settings to demonstrate effectiveness under varying bitrates and domain shifts.

评测协议。为从机器侧评估 TFGC，我们在多个下游场景开展实验，涵盖不同视觉语言任务和压缩设置，以展示其在码率变化与域偏移下的有效性。

For fair comparison, VVC [6] employs QP values of 48, 50, and 55 (≈0.06/0.04/0.02 bpp), TiTok [61] uses TiToksl256 and TiTokbl128 variants (0.06/0.02 bpp), and FlexTok [2] adopts the d18–d18 configuration.

为公平比较，VVC [6] 使用 QP 48、50、55，约对应0.06、0.04、0.02 bpp；TiTok [61] 使用 TiTok-sl256 和 TiTok-bl128，分别对应0.06与0.02 bpp；FlexTok [2] 使用 d18–d18 配置。

Benchmarks include image captioning (MSCOCO [37], Flickr30k [60]) evaluated by ROUGE-L [36];

基准包括：使用 ROUGE-L [36] 评估的图像描述任务（MSCOCO [37]、Flickr30k [60]）；

vision grounding (RefCOCO, RefCOCOg [24, 43]) evaluated by Acc@0.5 (IoU≥0.5 [14]);

使用 Acc@0.5、即 IoU≥0.5 [14] 评估的视觉定位任务（RefCOCO、RefCOCOg [24,43]）；

and VQA (VQAv2, OKVQA [16, 45]) using accuracy. Results. As shown in Table 1, TFGC consistently achieves the highest performance across all downstream tasks and bitrate ranges.

使用准确率评估的视觉问答任务（VQAv2、OKVQA [16,45]）。结果。如表1所示，作者称 TFGC 在各下游任务与码率范围内持续取得最高性能。

At the highest bitrate (0.06 bpp), TFGC surpasses existing compression methods on captioning (MSCOCO: 49.94, Flickr30k: 39.04) tasks, while maintaining comparable performance to the best single-rate model in grounding and VQA tasks.

在最高码率设置0.06 bpp下，TFGC 在图像描述任务上超过现有压缩方法，MSCOCO 和 Flickr30k 得分分别为49.94和39.04，同时在定位与视觉问答任务上保持与最佳单码率模型相近的性能。

This indicates that the proposed token-based representation preserves semantic fidelity even under moderate compression.

这表明，所提出的 token 表示即使在中等压缩程度下也能保持语义保真度。

Under the extremely lowbitrate setting (0.02 bpp), where traditional codecs fail to preserve high-level semantics, TFGC still yields competitive results—achieving 48.32 ROUGE-L on MSCOCO, 54.96 accuracy@0.5 on RefCOCO, and 62.37 accuracy on VQAv2—surpassing all baselines by a large margin.

在0.02 bpp的极低码率设置下，传统编解码器难以保留高层语义，而 TFGC 仍有竞争力：MSCOCO 的 ROUGE-L 为48.32，RefCOCO 的 Acc@0.5 为54.96，VQAv2 准确率为62.37，作者认为其显著优于基线。

This demonstrates that the proposed token-semantic design enables LVLMs to directly exploit compressed representations for reasoning, avoiding the semantic collapse typically observed at ultra-low bitrates.

这表明，token 语义设计使 LVLM 能直接利用压缩表示进行推理，避免超低码率下常见的语义崩塌。

Qualitative grounding results at 0.06 bpp are shown in Fig. 6, further illustrating the superior localization accuracy and semantic consistency of TFGC.

图6给出了0.06 bpp下的定位可视化，进一步展示 TFGC 的定位精度与语义一致性。

Overall, TFGC maintains stable and superior performance across diverse tasks and compression levels, proving its effectiveness in semantic understanding within a single compression framework.

总体而言，TFGC 在多任务和不同压缩程度下保持稳定且较强的性能，说明单一压缩框架能够有效支持语义理解。

More detailed results are provided in the Appendix.

更多结果见附录。

4.3. Human-Oriented Evaluation

4.3. 面向人类的评测

Evaluation Protocol. We conduct systematic experiments on the ImageNet validation set using two reconstruction metrics (PSNR, SSIM) and three perceptual metrics (LPIPS [65], DISTS [11], and CLIP-IQA [57]).

评测协议。我们在 ImageNet 验证集上进行系统实验，使用 PSNR、SSIM 两项重建指标，以及 LPIPS [65]、DISTS [11]、CLIP-IQA [57] 三项感知指标。

LPIPS and DISTS assess perceptual and structural similarity with reference images, while CLIP-IQA captures naturalness and semantic alignment without reference.

LPIPS 和 DISTS 评价相对于参考图像的感知与结构相似性，CLIP-IQA 则在无参考条件下反映自然度与语义相关质量。

This combination jointly reflects both pixel-level fidelity and perceptual realism.

这些指标共同反映像素级保真度和感知真实感。结果。

Results. As shown in Table 2, TFGC achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and perceptual realism across all bitrate settings. At 0.06 bpp, it yields the lowest LPIPS (0.12) and DISTS (0.11), indicating superior perceptual similarity and structural consistency among learned compression methods.

如表2所示，TFGC 在所有码率设置下均较好地平衡了重建保真度与感知真实感。在0.06 bpp下，其 LPIPS 最低，为0.12，DISTS 最低，为0.11，表明其在学习式压缩方法中具有较好的感知相似性与结构一致性。

At 0.04 bpp, TFGC continues to deliver stable perceptual quality, as reflected by the lowest LPIPS and DISTS scores.

在0.04 bpp下，最低的 LPIPS 和 DISTS 得分表明 TFGC 仍能保持稳定感知质量。

While VVC reports higher PSNR and SSIM due to its pixel-level optimization, its perceptual quality metrics degrade sharply, showing that numerical fidelity does not correlate with human visual preference.

VVC 因像素级优化而具有更高的 PSNR 和 SSIM，但其感知质量指标显著变差，说明数值保真度不一定与人类视觉偏好一致。

Importantly, TFGC is explicitly designed to optimize downstream understanding tasks while preserving humanaligned perceptual quality, prioritizing realistic visual experience and robust semantic understanding under lightweight parameter and bitrate budgets.

TFGC 的设计目标是在保持符合人类感知的质量的同时优化下游理解任务，在较轻量的参数规模和码率预算下，优先保证真实的视觉体验与稳健的语义理解。

4.4. Complexity Analysis

4.4. 复杂度分析

Table 3 summarizes the computational efficiency of representative compression frameworks.

表3总结了代表性压缩框架的计算效率。

TFGC achieves near real-time performance, with 13 ms encoding and 38 ms decoding per 256×256 image—comparable to the lightweight TiTok baseline and substantially faster than generative codecs such as DiffEIC and FlexTok.

TFGC 对每张256×256图像的编码耗时13 ms、解码耗时38 ms，达到接近实时的性能，与轻量 TiTok 基线相当，且显著快于 DiffEIC、FlexTok 等生成式编解码器。

Compared with ELIC and FlexTok, TFGC provides a more favorable speed–quality trade-off, maintaining low latency while supporting variable-bitrate control.

与 ELIC 和 FlexTok 相比，TFGC 在保持低延迟并支持可变码率控制的同时，获得了较好的速度与质量权衡。

Overall, TFGC combines high compression flexibility with efficient inference, making it well-suited for bandwidth-constrained or resourcelimited scenarios such as satellite links and edge devices.

总体而言，TFGC 结合了较高压缩灵活性与高效推理，适用于卫星链路、边缘设备等带宽或资源受限场景。

4.5. Ablation Study

4.5. 消融研究

Effectiveness of TFP. To evaluate the effectiveness of the TFP module, we conduct an ablation by removing the TFP module and instead learning an unconditional prediction for the masked tokens ˆxm.

TFP 的有效性。为评估 TFP，我们移除该模块，改为学习掩蔽 token x̂m 的无条件预测。

Specifically, we initialize the masked tokens y by sampling from a standard Gaussian distribution and directly replace the missing positions with the sampled tokens according to the specified mask ratio, forcing the model to learn an unconditional distribution for masked tokens.

具体而言，从标准高斯分布采样初始化掩蔽 token y，并按给定掩蔽比例直接替换缺失位置，迫使模型学习掩蔽 token 的无条件分布。

As shown in Table 4, under identical training settings and the same number of training steps, the model with the TFP module consistently outperforms its counterpart without TFP in both subjective and objective metrics.

如表4所示，在相同训练设置与步数下，使用 TFP 的模型在主观和客观指标上持续优于不使用 TFP 的版本。

This validates the effectiveness of TFP in enhancing rate-adaptive representation while preserving perceptual quality under varying bitrate constraints.

这验证了 TFP 在不同码率约束下增强码率自适应表示、同时保持感知质量的有效性。

Table 5. Ablation study on the TSG module. The average results of MSCOCO (ROUGE-L↑), RefCOCO (Acc@0.5↑), VQAv2 (Acc↑) across three bitrate levels are reported.

表5. TSG 模块消融。报告三个码率等级上 MSCOCO 的 ROUGE-L↑、RefCOCO 的 Acc@0.5↑ 和 VQAv2 的准确率↑的平均结果。

Table 6. Ablation study on the PSA training paradigm. The average results of MSCOCO (ROUGE-L↑), RefCOCO (Acc@0.5↑), VQAv2 (Acc↑) across three bitrate levels are reported.

表6. PSA 训练范式消融。报告三个码率等级上 MSCOCO 的 ROUGE-L↑、RefCOCO 的 Acc@0.5↑ 和 VQAv2 的准确率↑的平均结果。

Effectiveness of TSG. To assess the role of the TSG module in guiding token semantic representation, we replace TSG with a standard MLP of equivalent parameter count.

TSG 的有效性。为评估 TSG 对 token 语义表示的引导作用，我们将其替换为参数量相同的标准 MLP。

Table 5 shows that replacing the TSG module with a parameter-equivalent MLP produces large, consistent performance drops across all evaluated tasks.

表5显示，该替换使所有评测任务的性能都出现显著且一致的下降。

These results confirm that TSG effectively aligns compressed token representations with the LLM’s semantic space, enabling more reliable visual semantic interpretation and yielding significant improvements under variable bitrate conditions.

结果说明，TSG 能有效将压缩 token 表示与 LLM 语义空间对齐，实现更可靠的视觉语义解释，并在可变码率条件下显著改善性能。

Impact of PSA Training Paradigm.

PSA 训练范式的影响。

Table 6 shows that the PSA training yields the best performance across downstream tasks, demonstrating the complementary roles of the two objectives.

表6显示，PSA 在下游任务上取得最佳结果，表明两个目标具有互补作用。

Specifically, LP SA1 serves as a semantic anchor that initializes and stabilizes the representation in the LLM-aligned feature space, while LP SA2 progressively refines task-specific alignment for downstream understanding, validating the effective design of the training strategy.

具体而言，LPSA1 作为语义锚点，在与 LLM 对齐的特征空间中初始化并稳定表示；LPSA2 则逐步细化面向下游理解的任务对齐，验证了该训练策略的有效性。

5. Conclusion

5. 结论

In this paper, we introduce TFGC, a token-based flexible compression framework that effectively unifies human- and machine-oriented perception objectives.

本文提出基于 token 的灵活压缩框架 TFGC，有效统一了面向人类和机器的感知目标。

By leveraging token flow propagation for variable bitrate and token semantic guidance for direct LVLMs consumption, TFGC addresses the critical misalignment of conventional techniques in ultra-low-bitrate regimes, which struggle to preserve semantic consistency with flexible bitrate control.

TFGC 使用 token 流传播支持可变码率，使用 token 语义引导支持 LVLM 直接处理压缩表示，解决了传统技术在超低码率下难以同时保持语义一致性与灵活码率控制的关键不匹配问题。

Through a coarse-to-fine training strategy, TFGC enables LVLMs to process compressed token streams directly without image reconstruction, achieving state-of-the-art machine understanding while maintaining satisfactory perceptual quality.

通过由粗到细的训练策略，TFGC 使 LVLM 无需图像重建即可直接处理压缩 token 流，在保持令人满意的感知质量的同时，实现领先的机器理解性能。

Extensive experiments demonstrate that TFGC provides an efficient and unified solution for visual communication systems that serve both human and machine perception.

大量实验表明，TFGC 为同时服务人类和机器感知的视觉通信系统提供了高效统一的解决方案。
